title: delivery.commit
description: Orders checkout hook, commit (after the order transaction commits). Binds the intent of attempt_key to order_id and creates the shipment; a commit after a checkout_failed/orphaned release still ships, after a cancelled release it is a no-op. Output: {ok: true}. Idempotent; acts on attempt_key alone (token may be null).

actor_id.description: The acting account id (a guest's own id, or the account), always sent by orders that know it; user_id stays null for a guest. Owner of this brick's rows; absent from older orders payloads.
